summary: Full arbitrary-matching T15 cores18,21,25 pass relative to imported Q4 N14; no global eight-hole closure claimed.
reviewer_model: current fresh Codex reviewer (no model override asserted)

obligations.subject: Quantifiers
obligations.evidence: Every arbitrary K(Q5) matching on exactly the 26 covered vertices; no shortness/parity restriction on required edges.

obligations.subject: Geometry
obligations.evidence: Cuts and common coordinate maps recover the three marked global omissions; core25 uses [3,0,1,2]. Cube automorphisms preserve all new-edge adjacencies, including parity reversal.

obligations.subject: Crossing exhaustion
obligations.evidence: Each face has 13 covered vertices: 2|F_A|+c=2|F_B|+c=13, so c in {1,3,5,7,9,11,13}.

obligations.subject: N14 import
obligations.evidence: All actual A hole triples have even local parity. For either bridge z, F_A union D has exactly the equal-parity holes x,w. N14 permits arbitrary long D and prescribes omission of x.

obligations.subject: Path deletion
obligations.evidence: D is a nonempty matching of a simple 15-cycle. Its deletion gives disjoint paths with exactly the D endpoints; R union D is connected. No original F_A edge is deleted.

obligations.subject: Internal mirror
obligations.evidence: The extra B mirror z has unique internal mate k outside the ports. Suppressing kz and its unique path produces a valid matching on the other twelve vertices. Recovering k's compressed mate reconstructs R injectively.

obligations.subject: Occupied mirror
obligations.evidence: For c>=3 prescribe z_A d in D. At least one other D edge is deleted, so its two ends lie in different remaining paths. The bridge/crossing join creates no closed component. Suppression gives Q union D-prime connected.

obligations.subject: Expansion
obligations.evidence: All compressed edges represent vertex-disjoint paths. Expansion of the B 14-cycle inserts 15 A vertices and the omitted B mirror z, giving exactly 30 vertices. All required edges survive; surviving new edges are short.

obligations.subject: Single-negative blocking
obligations.evidence: For bridge12 the table has one negative. In the internal c>=3 case and occupied c>=5 case, D=R0 or D-prime=Q0 has at least two edges; its union with itself is disconnected, so cannot be the N14 output.

obligations.subject: Inverse completeness
obligations.evidence: For every negative L enumerate all possible internal F_B submatchings. Internal mode inversely splits the edge kq into kz and zq; occupied mode takes L minus F_B. These are exact inverses of compression, and families not occurring are entirely positive.

obligations.subject: All large c blockers
obligations.evidence: The nine feasible (c,mode) classes for c>=5 are covered. Each of 2644 saved artificial pairings has the exact boundary and is graph-disconnected from every bad output. Internal c13 is impossible.

obligations.subject: Core25 transport
obligations.evidence: Swapping bits1,2 maps bridge3 to5 with holes0,7,8 fixed; swapping bits0,1 maps source bridges3,5 to target3,6. Raw-table negative families equal transported text families. Connectivity is invariant. No A omitted-label hypothesis occurs in this B certificate.

obligations.subject: Occupied c5
obligations.evidence: The only null families have all three boundary pairings bad. Each bridge has precisely two null internal matchings; target bridge3 and6 null sets have empty intersection. If a mirror is internal its blocker already applies.

obligations.subject: c3 realizability
obligations.evidence: The A four-vertex boundary has three pairings. If at most one were realizable, choosing that pairing as D would contradict connectedness of R union D. Thus at least two are realizable.

obligations.subject: c3 exhaustive B spectrum
obligations.evidence: For each core exhaust C(13,3)*9!!*3! = 1621620 ordered B inputs. Graph traversal rejects loops/closed components and checks exact compressed matching. Every histogram mask has at least two admissible pairings for one bridge; hence intersection with its A set is nonempty.

obligations.subject: Arbitrary bijections
obligations.evidence: Fix any order of actual A ports. Enumeration of every order of their B mates includes every original crossing bijection, with no length/parity condition.

obligations.subject: c1 exhaustive B spectrum
obligations.evidence: For each core exhaust 13*11!!=135135 B inputs. The sole abstract A pairing is realizable. There are exactly 3,2,20 nonadmissible B cases, identical to residual input sets without duplicates.

obligations.subject: Positive residual completeness
obligations.evidence: For each exceptional B case, all 13 A port choices and all 11!! A internal matchings are checked; the crossing is uniquely determined. Counts 405405+270270+2702700=3378375, all positive.

obligations.subject: Positive residual integrity
obligations.evidence: Recompiled verifiers regenerate every required matching, compare all 26 endpoint bytes, check 30 distinct vertices, exact omitted pair, all 13 required edges and every other edge short including closing edge; exact counts and EOF hold.

obligations.subject: Finite tables and scope
obligations.evidence: Independently rechecked 13 raw tables: each has all 10395 distinct valid arbitrary matchings. Every nonnegative cycle has exact support, all required edges and short additions. Negative entries need only be a conservative excluded set. No global eight-hole coverage, full T15 or core26 replacement is inferred.
